result.summary: Found 1 issue: delivery metadata text overlaps and becomes unreadable on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card.

issues.description: Under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar', the delivery-time and delivery-fee text collide, rendering as '25-30delivery · Ramen' with the 'min' and fee information missing or overlapped, so the metadata is not readable.
issues.suggestion: Give the metadata line enough width and spacing (or allow it to wrap) so the time, delivery fee, and cuisine render as separate, non-overlapping items, e.g. '25–30 min · €0 delivery · Ramen'.
